source: EDG Entsorgung Dortmund GmbH (www.edg.de) - check before final presentation

categories.name: recyclable
categories.description: Can be recycled: packaging, paper, glass, metal, textiles, electronics

categories.name: compostable
categories.description: Organic waste for the Biotonne (brown bin)

categories.name: landfill
categories.description: Residual or hazardous waste that cannot be recycled at home

items.label: plastic bottle
items.instruction: Bottles with the Pfand logo: return to any supermarket machine and get your deposit back.

items.label: aluminium can
items.instruction: Drink cans with the Pfand logo: return to the supermarket deposit machine.

items.label: beer bottle
items.instruction: Reusable glass bottle (Mehrweg): return to the store with the crate or deposit machine.

items.label: shampoo bottle
items.instruction: Empty the bottle. No rinsing needed. Leave the cap on.

items.label: detergent bottle
items.instruction: Empty completely and close the cap.

items.label: yogurt cup
items.instruction: Scrape it empty. Remove the aluminium lid and put it in the bin separately.

items.label: plastic bag
items.instruction: Put it in loose. Do not stuff other waste inside.

items.label: plastic food tray
items.instruction: Remove food leftovers. Separate the plastic film from the tray.

items.label: cling film
items.instruction: Put plastic film in loose, not rolled into a ball.

items.label: chip bag
items.instruction: Empty the bag of crumbs before throwing it away.

items.label: blister pack
items.instruction: Make sure all tablets are removed.

items.label: styrofoam packaging
items.instruction: Small pieces go in the yellow bin. Large amounts: Recyclinghof.

items.label: plastic cutlery
items.instruction: Wipe off food leftovers.

items.label: plastic toy
items.instruction: Only toys without batteries or electronics. Remove batteries first.

items.label: to-go coffee cup
items.instruction: Coated paper cups and plastic lids go in the yellow bin, not the blue bin.

items.label: beverage carton
items.instruction: Milk and juice cartons (Tetra Pak): empty and flatten, leave the cap on.

items.label: tin can
items.instruction: Empty the food can. Push the lid inside carefully to avoid cuts.

items.label: aluminium foil
items.instruction: Remove food leftovers and press it into a loose ball.

items.label: metal lid
items.instruction: Lids from glass jars go in the yellow bin, not the glass container.

items.label: bottle cap
items.instruction: Plastic or metal caps from non-deposit bottles go in the yellow bin.

items.label: spray can
items.instruction: Only completely empty cans. Cans with leftovers: Schadstoffmobil.

items.label: coffee capsule
items.instruction: Aluminium or plastic capsules go in the yellow bin.

items.label: cooking pot
items.instruction: Small metal items fit in the combined Wertstofftonne. Large items: Recyclinghof.

items.label: newspaper
items.instruction: Keep it dry. Remove plastic wrapping.

items.label: magazine
items.instruction: Remove plastic covers and free samples.

items.label: cardboard box
items.instruction: Flatten the box. Remove tape and plastic parts.

items.label: paper bag
items.instruction: Only clean and dry bags.

items.label: egg carton
items.instruction: Cardboard egg cartons go in the blue bin. Plastic ones go in the yellow bin.

items.label: toilet paper roll
items.instruction: Empty cardboard rolls go in the blue bin.

items.label: envelope
items.instruction: Envelopes with a plastic window are also allowed.

items.label: office paper
items.instruction: Remove plastic folders. Staples can stay.

items.label: book
items.instruction: Remove hard plastic covers. Good books can be donated instead.

items.label: pizza box
items.instruction: Only clean boxes. Greasy or dirty parts go in the grey bin.

items.label: glass jar
items.instruction: Remove the lid. Sort by colour: white, green or brown.

items.label: wine bottle
items.instruction: Sort by colour. Blue or other colours go in the green container.

items.label: glass bottle
items.instruction: Non-deposit glass bottles only. Remove the cap and sort by colour.

items.label: perfume bottle
items.instruction: Empty glass bottle goes in the glass container. Remove the spray head.

items.label: battery
items.instruction: Never put in household bins - fire risk. Return to the collection box in supermarkets or drugstores.

items.label: smartphone
items.instruction: Delete your data. Bring to an EDG Recyclinghof or return to an electronics store.

items.label: small electronic device
items.instruction: Electronic devices never go in household bins. Remove batteries first.

items.label: led bulb
items.instruction: LED and energy-saving bulbs contain electronics. Bring to the Recyclinghof or a store.

items.label: clothes
items.instruction: Clean and dry clothes in a closed bag.

items.label: shoes
items.instruction: Tie the shoes together in pairs.

items.label: banana peel
items.instruction: Put in the brown bin. No plastic bags, also no compostable plastic bags.

items.label: apple core
items.instruction: Fruit leftovers go in the brown bin.

items.label: vegetable scraps
items.instruction: Peels and scraps go in the brown bin. Wrap in newspaper to keep the bin clean.

items.label: citrus peel
items.instruction: Orange and lemon peels go in the brown bin.

items.label: coffee grounds
items.instruction: Coffee grounds and paper filters go in the brown bin.

items.label: tea bag
items.instruction: Remove the metal clip if there is one.

items.label: eggshell
items.instruction: Eggshells go in the brown bin.

items.label: bread
items.instruction: Old bread and bakery leftovers go in the brown bin.

items.label: food leftovers
items.instruction: Food leftovers without packaging go in the brown bin.

items.label: nut shells
items.instruction: Nut shells go in the brown bin.

items.label: flowers
items.instruction: Cut flowers and houseplants without the pot.

items.label: leaves
items.instruction: Garden waste goes in the brown bin. Large amounts: Recyclinghof.

items.label: diaper
items.instruction: Diapers always go in the grey bin.

items.label: used tissue
items.instruction: Used tissues and paper towels go in the grey bin.

items.label: cigarette butt
items.instruction: Make sure it is fully out before throwing it away.

items.label: dirty pizza box
items.instruction: Greasy cardboard cannot be recycled. Tear off clean parts for the blue bin.

items.label: receipt
items.instruction: Thermal paper receipts contain chemicals and go in the grey bin.

items.label: drinking glass
items.instruction: Drinking glasses melt differently from bottle glass. Do not put them in the glass container.

items.label: broken mirror
items.instruction: Wrap the pieces in newspaper to protect the waste workers.

items.label: ceramic plate
items.instruction: Porcelain and ceramics go in the grey bin, never in the glass container.

items.label: light bulb
items.instruction: Only old incandescent bulbs. LED and energy-saving bulbs go to the Recyclinghof.

items.label: vacuum cleaner bag
items.instruction: Close the bag before putting it in the grey bin.

items.label: cat litter
items.instruction: All types of cat litter go in the grey bin, never in the brown bin.

items.label: chewing gum
items.instruction: Wrap it in paper and put it in the grey bin.

items.label: baking paper
items.instruction: Coated baking paper cannot be recycled.

items.label: photo
items.instruction: Photo paper is coated and goes in the grey bin.

items.label: sponge
items.instruction: Used kitchen sponges go in the grey bin.

items.label: medicine
items.instruction: Put old medicine in the grey bin or bring it to a pharmacy. Never flush it down the toilet.

items.label: paint can
items.instruction: Cans with paint leftovers are hazardous waste. Bring to the EDG Schadstoffmobil. Dried, empty cans: yellow bin.
